descriptions.w3d_d29e_print_array_801ef970: Writes the elements of the array property at the prop's offset in object: through the type's write slot if 0x801fff60 says it is a kind-three type, otherwise printing each element into a temporary string and writing that; elements are separated by the text at 0x803b0d60 plus an optional line break and indent, and printing stops with the text at 0x803b0d68 at the given limit. Names are inferred.
